title: MACES — Banking Conversational AI
description: A multilingual conversational AI for banking client support, from model fine-tuning and RAG pipeline design to full Dockerized deployment on Azure via Terraform, with a CI/CD pipeline.

title: Face Detection + Age/Gender Recognition
description: A computer vision project detecting faces and predicting age/gender in real time.

title: my wordle
description: A cozy, pastel-pink take on Wordle — built with Expo. Guess the word (3 to 6 letters) in the same number of tries as its length, with a soft, minimal keyboard and board.

title: Maris
description: Maris is a fitness plan generator and tracker for mobile. It builds a personalised workout plan from a 5-step profile test, adjusting for age, availability, injuries, and health history. Users log workouts, macros, water, and sleep, and see streaks and monthly stats.

title: Book tracker
description: A full-stack mobile app designed to make reading distraction-free. Features a custom 3D animated character that reads alongside you, interactive reading sessions with a stopwatch, text and voice note-taking, and ambient focus sounds. Built with React Native, Expo, and a custom Node.js backend.

title: Bioworld: Interactive Evolution Simulator
description:
Bioworld is a real-time, open-ended ecosystem simulator built from scratch. Users can drop creatures into a sandbox, paint environments (desert, cold, normal), and watch as the creatures' DNA mutates over generations to survive. 

The simulation features a custom-built genetic engine where survival drives adaptation. Creatures naturally evolve traits like fur, heat resistance, and even predatory behaviors based on environmental pressures and starvatio. The project also includes an educational portal explaining the real-world biology behind the simulation.
